decisions.reason: The aloe vera line has its own page in both years, which signals a firm commitment, and small-batch production keeps its carrying cost low, so the option is worth holding while the line builds its customer base.
The hyaluronic serum is still listed after two years and sits close to the core offer, so keeping it costs little and its value is not yet clear enough to justify abandoning it.
The cleansing oil launched only in 2024, so its uncertainty has not yet resolved, and it may replace the dropped cleansing milk, which makes keeping this cheap option open the sensible choice.
